description: Returns the generic organic click-through-rate curve by Google position (1–20, fraction 0–1) used by score_opportunities and find_page_poaching_opportunities as the fallback when a property lacks its own volume, optionally interpolated for a fractional position. No account needed; no property data involved. Use it to estimate expected clicks for a position or to explain a CTR gap. / Curva genérica de CTR por posição, sem login.

impressions.description: Optional impressions to convert the expected CTR into expected clicks.

position.description: Optional fractional position (e.g. 4.6) to get the interpolated expected CTR.

name: get_ctr_benchmark
title: Generic CTR-by-position benchmark
